title: Waka Waka
_notation: Per hand, one string per bar. Tokens: pitch (G4, Bb3, C#5), rest r. Suffix :n = length in eighths (default 1; fractions like 1/2 allowed). Prefix ~ = tied from the previous token of the same pitch (no new attack). Every bar must sum to 8 eighths. Single-staff source (treble, no key signature): the whole melody is in rh, lh is whole-bar rests. The printed repeat of bars 17-20 (|: ... :|) is written out: printed 1-20 are indices 1-20, printed 17-20 again are 21-24.

sections.name: Verse
sections.hint: "You're a good soldier, choosing your battles": each line starts after a quarter rest, a dotted eighth-sixteenth on F, then G and back. Bars 3-4 and 7-8 run in sixteenths, with a short tie into each group (F held over from the eighth before). Right hand only; the left hand rests all through.
sections.coach: Right hand alone. Count the quarter rest that opens bars 1, 2, 5 and 6.

sections.name: Pre-chorus
sections.hint: "When you fall get up, oh oh": F, G, F, then A held across the bar line into a quarter, up to C5 and a dotted quarter on A. Bars 11-12 repeat 9-10 note for note.
sections.coach: The A at the end of bars 9 and 11 is held over the bar line — no new attack.

sections.name: Chorus
sections.hint: "Tsamina mina eh eh, waka waka eh eh": the sixteenth figure on one note (eighth, two sixteenths tied into two more, eighth) on F, then G, then A; the third sixteenth is tied to the fourth, so it is five attacks, not six. "This time for Africa" is the plain eighths of bar 16.
sections.coach: Tsa-mi-na mi-na: five attacks on each repeated note, the middle one held through the tie.

sections.name: Chorus, second time
sections.hint: The chorus again, marked to repeat. Bar 17 ends with an eighth rest, G, then F; bar 18 is four plain eighths on G (waka waka). Bars 19-20 match 15-16.
sections.coach: Same chorus — watch the eighth rest in bar 17 and the straight eighths in bar 18.

sections.name: Chorus, last time
sections.hint: The written-out repeat of bars 17-20, note for note, to the final bar line.
sections.coach: Last time through. Finish on the quarter F.
